# 0008. Idempotency keys in Redis

Status: accepted

## Context
Clients retry charge requests on timeouts. A repeated request with the same Idempotency-Key must not charge twice.

## Decision
Store each key in Redis with SET NX and a 24 hour TTL. The first request wins; later requests with the same key return the stored response or 409 while it is pending.

## Alternatives
A unique constraint in Postgres would be durable but adds a write to the hot path and keeps keys forever, which needs a cleanup job.

## Consequences
Keys expire after 24 hours, so retries later than that are treated as new charges. A Redis outage disables the check; the endpoint then fails closed with 503.
